turns.user: Predict the 28-day compressive strength and flow table spread of an OPC mortar with w/b 0.40, s/b 2.0 and 0.5 % PCE superplasticiser. Briefly.
turns.text:
I’ll check the input conventions and predict both properties.
| Property | q50 [q10, q90] |
|---|---:|
| 28-day compressive strength | **44.4 [27.9, 75.3] MPa** |
| Fresh flow-table spread | **184.4 [130.0, 240.7] mm** |

Assumed moist curing, `comp_cube50`, natural sand, non-3DCP conditions, and PCE dosage by product mass relative to binder.

Flow is **order-of-magnitude guidance** from a weak model. Published measurements deserve priority: [mix W0.4](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2025.114485) reports **184 mm**, but its composition differs substantially, so it does not validate this mix. Experimental verification is needed.
